article.story: AMHERST, Mass. -- — Junjie Wang's 28 points helped UMass defeat UMass-Lowell 72-62 on Wednesday. Wang added nine rebounds for the Minutemen (2-1). Jordan Clayton scored 17 points while going 6 of 12 (3 for 7 from 3-point range), and added five rebounds. Victor Okojie led the River Hawks (3-1) in scoring, finishing with 13 points. UMass-Lowell also got 10 points from Christian Jones. UMass pulled off the victory after a 9-0 second-half run erased a six-point deficit and gave them the lead at 53-50 with 8:04 remaining in the half. Clayton scored 12 second-half points. Up next Both teams next play Tuesday. UMass hosts Bryant, and UMass-Lowellsquares off against Saint Peter's at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
